about: Frozen 2026-10-17, BEFORE any word-pass pattern for the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 or the Prevention of Damage to Public Property Act, 1984 was written (owner's go: "Yes, build the Muslim Women and Public Property patterns"). Written by Claude, so the same author writes the patterns: treat the score as a ceiling, not a forecast. 'want' is the Directory id the question should reach, or null when neither of the two Acts should be raised. The negatives are near-misses on purpose (talaq-e-hasan, khula, maintenance, private property, an accident, a demolition, a government bus that hit a scooter).
